mapper.select:
SELECT ccb.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_code, v.invoice_kind, hbm.invoice_title, hbm.tax_registry_num, hbm.INVOICE_BP_ADDRESS_PHONE_NUM, hbm.INVOICE_BP_BANK_ACCOUNT, hbm.TAXPAYER_TYPE, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND v.invoice_kind = v.code_value) invoice_kind_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_TAXPAYER_TYPE' AND hbm.taxpayer_type = v.code_value) taxpayer_type_n FROM prj_project_bp ccb, hls_bp_master hbm,
con_contract_cashflow ccc left join con_contract cc on cc.contract_id = ccc.contract_id left join vat_invoice_profile_dtl v on v.invoice_profile = (case when (cc.business_type = 'LEASE' and cc.lease_item_property = 'MOVABLE') THEN 'LEASE_MOVABLES' when (cc.business_type = 'LEASE' and cc.lease_item_property = 'IMMOVABLE') THEN 'LEASE_IMMOVABLES' when (cc.business_type = 'LEASEBACK' and cc.lease_item_property = 'MOVABLE') THEN 'LEASEBACK_MOVABLES' when (cc.business_type = 'LEASEBACK' and cc.lease_item_property = 'IMMOVABLE') THEN 'LEASEBACK_IMMOVABLES' else '' end) and v.cf_item = ccc.cf_item WHERE ccb.project_id = cc.project_id and hbm.BP_ID = ccb.bp_id and ccc.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId}
and hbm.bp_code like concat('%',concat(#{bpCode},'%'))
and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))

select hbm.BP_CODE, ccb.bp_name, ccb.bank_account_name, ccb.bank_account_num, ccb.bank_branch_name, ba.BANK_FULL_NAME from con_contract_bp ccb left join hls_bp_master_bank_account ba on ccb.bp_id = ba.BP_ID , hls_bp_master hbm where ccb.bp_category = 'TENANT' and hbm.BP_ID = ccb.bp_id
and ccb.contract_id = #{contractId}

select hbm.BP_CODE, ccb.bp_name, ccb.bank_account_name, ccb.bank_account_num, ccb.bank_branch_name, ba.BANK_FULL_NAME from con_contract_bp ccb left join hls_bp_master_bank_account ba on ccb.bp_id = ba.BP_ID , hls_bp_master hbm where ccb.bp_category = 'GUARANTOR' and hbm.BP_ID = ccb.bp_id
and ccb.contract_id = #{contractId}

select hbm.bp_id,hbm.bp_name,hbm.bp_code from hls_bp_master hbm
and hbm.bp_code like concat('%',concat(#{bpCode},'%'))
and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))

select hbm.bp_id,hbm.bp_name,hbm.bp_code,ccb.bp_category,ccb.contract_id from con_contract_bp ccb LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON ccb.bp_id=hbm.bp_id where ccb.bp_id=hbm.bp_id and ccb.contract_id= #{contractId}

SELECT cc.contract_number, cc.contract_name, pq.quotation_number, ccc.cashflow_id from con_contract cc, prj_quotation pq, con_contract_cashflow ccc where cc.contract_status='INCEPT' and pq.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='CONTRACT' AND pq.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID=cc.contract_id AND pq.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' AND ccc.generated_source='PRJ_QUOTATION' AND ccc.generated_source_doc_id=pq.QUOTATION_ID AND ccc.cf_item=0 and ccc.cf_type=0
and cc.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and cc.contract_name like concat('%',concat(#{contractName},'%'))

SELECT cb.record_id, cb.contract_id, cb.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_name bp_name_n, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_class, cb.bp_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.CODE = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE' AND sc.code_value = cb.bp_type ) bp_type_n, hbm.economic_indu_classify, ( SELECT t.description FROM hls_stat_class t WHERE t.class_usage = 'BIZ_PARTNER' AND t.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND to_char( t.CLASS_ID ) = hbm.economic_indu_classify ) economic_indu_classify_n, hbm.group_companies, cb.description FROM con_contract_bp cb INNER JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id = cb.bp_id
cb.contract_id = #{contractId}
